title: Associate Software Engineer
must_have: 1+ years of experience in software engineering
text:
Associate Software Engineer
Brahmaputra Labs | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a associate software engineer to join our software engineering team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Java
- Python
- Git
- SQL
- System Design
- 1+ years of experience in software engineering

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- AWS
- Microservices
- Docker
- Kafka

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive notification delivery overhaul with measurable outcomes.
- Drive internal developer tooling with measurable outcomes.
- Drive order-management backend modernisation with measurable outcomes.
